sections.text: مقدمة

يوضح هذا المستند فحص المعدات I1، الذي يجب إجراؤه عليه 
القواعد الأسبوعية كما هو موضح بواسطة W1 في كتلة العنوان.

The CPX 928 is a single 
slot CPU for the C80-75 MFC that is programmed and configured by Windows based 
programming software to perform real time control of machines, processes, and 
material handling systems. It communicates with I/O and smart option modules 
over a rack mounted backplane using the VME C.1 Standard format.

The first draft is initiated by eng. Mohamed Tawfeeq, tested by 
eng. Bahaa Abd El-Wahab, revised by MDEPC quality control eng. Adel El Naggar, accepted by 
general manager eng. Mohamed Elshreif, approved by eng. Ahmed Sawan head sector 
of Nubaria power station .

This document certified by eng. Samir Abd El Gillil 
MDEPC quality control general manager and MPIS coordinator and approved by eng. Mohammed Nageb 
quality control head sector.

sections.text:
First, make sure rack power is turned off. Then, use a medium-blade, 
 slotted screwdriver to loosen the top and bottom holding screws just 
 enough to free the module from the rack. Note: Screws are held captive in 
 the module, so they do not have to be removed from the module.

Grasp the board firmly at the top and bottom of the board cover with your 
 thumbs on the front of the cover and your fingers on the plastic rack 
 clips on the back of the cover.

Squeeze the rack clips on the back of the cover with your fingers to 
 disengage the clips from the rack rail, and then pull the board firmly 
 toward you until it clears the rack.

Removing a Module
First, make sure rack power is turned off. Then, use a medium-blade, 
 slotted screwdriver to loosen the top and bottom holding screws just 
 enough to free the module from the rack. Note: Screws are held captive in 
 the module, so they do not have to be removed from the module.
Grasp the board firmly at the top and bottom of the board cover with your 
 thumbs on the front of the cover and your fingers on the plastic rack 
 clips on the back of the cover.
Squeeze the rack clips on the back of the cover with your fingers to 
 disengage the clips from the rack rail, and then pull the board firmly 
 toward you until it clears the rack.
